summary: F2-F4 are closed. F1 remains open: the baseline type-check rule is measurable but can accept new type errors in files that already had errors.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] spec D6 and plan tasks 1.1 and 3.1: The baseline-error allowance does not prove the dependency refresh introduced no new type errors. Rationale: The check allows any current diagnostics in base-dirty files while their aggregate count stays at or below 210; a new error can replace a removed error and pass. Compare diagnostics by file and error identity against the baseline, or define a narrower explicit acceptance rule that detects new errors in already-dirty files. The current rule is falsifiable but not sufficient as a regression gate.
